acceptable_fixes: Rewrite the recursion as a bounded loop in the same function.
Manually unroll the small fixed number of iterations.
Split helpers so calls form a directed acyclic graph.
canonical_fix: Remove the recursive bpf2bpf call and express the repeated work as a verifier-bounded loop or as an acyclic/unrolled call sequence.
expected_explanation: helper_a contains a bpf2bpf call to itself, creating a recursive subprogram call graph. The verifier requires an acyclic finite call graph even if the source-level branch appears bounded.
must_mention: The bpf2bpf call graph is recursive
Verifier requires no recursive subprogram calls
A bounded loop or acyclic rewrite is needed

scoring.0: Unrelated or does not identify the verifier failure.
scoring.1: Broad area only, no actionable source-level fix.
scoring.3: Source-level fix likely to satisfy verifier, but imprecise.
scoring.4: Minimal intended fix or equivalent patch with correct reasoning.

wrong_if: Only changes the branch bound from 4 to another number
Adds a runtime recursion depth counter but keeps the self-call
Treats the failure as stack memory bounds
